rows.grounds: feminine epithet describing the goddess as not born
feminine epithet identifying the goddess as mother

items.question: What essential qualities define the nature of the supreme goddess?
premises: The goddess is described as unborn.
The goddess is described as a mother.
The goddess is described as eternal.
The goddess is described as victorious.
The goddess is described as radiant.
The goddess is described as auspicious.
items.inference: The supreme goddess unites transcendent originlessness, generative motherhood, eternality, victory, radiance, and auspiciousness.
uncertainties: The specific referent among the mahāvidyās or forms of śakti is not explicitly named in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: She is unborn, the mother, eternal, victorious, radiant, and auspicious.
